details.description: Dolphin 2.6 Mixtral 8x7b is a chat model from Cognitive Computations (Eric Hartford), fine-tuned from Mistral AI's Mixtral-8x7b using qLoRA for about 1.5 epochs over the Dolphin dataset plus coding-focused Magicoder instruction data, in ChatML format, with training supported by Convai. Like other Dolphin releases, the maker filtered alignment and safety training out of the data, producing a highly compliant 'uncensored' model that the maker says requires an added alignment layer before being deployed as a service. It is released under the Apache 2.0 license.
advantages: Trained on a large coding-focused dataset (Magicoder OSS Instruct and Evol Instruct, about 186,000 examples combined: 75.2k + 111k per the model card's dataset listing) that the maker says makes it 'really good at coding'.
Apache 2.0 license permits commercial and non-commercial use.
disadvantages: Deliberately uncensored: the maker filtered alignment and bias out of the training data and states it 'will be highly compliant to any requests, even unethical ones,' recommending an added alignment layer before deploying it as a service.
Fine-tuned using a 16k-token training sequence length, half of the Mixtral-8x7b base model's 32k context.
English-language training data only, per the maker's model card.
use_cases: Coding assistance, given its coding-heavy training mix.

notes: Catalog facts list 32768 max input/output tokens, matching the Mixtral-8x7b base model's 32k context; the model card notes the Dolphin fine-tune itself used a shorter 16k training sequence length, reflected as a disadvantage rather than a change to the catalog's context-window fact. No benchmark table was found on the model card, so evaluations is left empty rather than guessed.
